title: Aye mere quwwate bazu mere bhai Abbas
body:
Y MERE QUWATE BAZU MERE BHAYI ABBAS asws.
THAAM KAR TOOTI KAMAR SHEH NE SADA DI ABBAS asws., 1. CHOD KAR HUMKO NA DUNIYA SE SIDHARO BHAYI.
HAI TAMANNA MERI EK BAAR PUKARO BHAYI.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. AB TO QANJAR MERI GARDAN PE CHALAYEGA LAYEE’N
NOKE NAIZA PE MERE SAR KO PHIRAYEGA LAYEE’N
<<DIVIDER>>
3. JAA’N BALAB HAAL TERA DEKH KE DIL ROTA HAI
BHAYI KIS HAAL MEIN TU MUJHSE JUDA HOTA HAI.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. AAYI ABBAS E DILAWAR KO FASIH AB JO QAZA.
DAAL DI LASHE PE APNI SHAHE WAALA NE ABA .
